crossRefs.note: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;
then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be…
“A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.
“As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in…
in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his…
I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head…
All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’ ”
For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his…

translations.web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
translations.bsb: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
translations.kjv: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
translations.asv: But as for me I know that my Redeemer liveth, And at last he will stand up upon the earth:
